query.sql: SELECT * FROM scope_summary ORDER BY sample_filter;
query.description: Counts dataset and biological-sample scope, technical integrity, and audited downstream availability.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: dataset_count = topology dataset rows in the selected view.
biological_count = distinct biological_id values; HCC1395_DORADO remains a technical replicate.
technical_replicate_n = datasets marked technical_replicate=true in the selected view.
hash_match_n, sample_identity_match_n, and receipt_technical_pass_n are separate technical gate counts.
integrity_pass_rate = datasets passing hash, sample identity, and technical receipt gates / datasets in view.
technical_gate_pass_n = datasets with receipt_all_pass=true.
all_families_complete_n = datasets with receipt_all_mutation_bearing_families_complete=true.
all_objective_certified_n = datasets with receipt_all_units_objective_certified=true.
biological macro median/P25/P75 use SQL PERCENTILE_CONT-style linear interpolation and exclude rows marked technical_replicate=true.
downstream_available_count = datasets with an audited drilldown bundle; availability does not imply scientific validation.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM availability ORDER BY sample_filter, component;
query.description: Shows the measured availability boundary for topology, ISM, lineage/LCA, and truth benchmarking.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: coverage = available datasets / expected topology datasets in the selected view.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM bam_scope_summary ORDER BY sample_filter;
query.description: Selected-scope tumor/normal/reference readiness, strict-identity categories, missing read groups, and caller-directory review counts.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: payload sample match = first/middle/last frozen 1 MiB chunks plus size/index checks; it is not a full-content BAM hash.
strict storage identity match = all three roles MATCH; mount-device drift = all three roles are MATCH or MOUNT_DEVICE_DRIFT_ONLY and at least one role has that bounded drift status.
tag receipt pass uses existing producer sidecar validation, not a new primary-read scan.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM bam_input_identity ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Per-dataset bounded payload, BAM index, header dictionary, source-directory pairing, and full-hash availability details.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: tumor_bam_gib and normal_bam_gib = file size bytes / 1024^3.
UNAVAILABLE_NO_RG means BAM headers contain no @RG SM field, so header identity cannot be asserted.
CROSS_DIRECTORY_REVIEW_REQUIRED is a transfer/confound flag, not evidence of corruption.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM read_tag_rates ORDER BY sample_filter, sample, metric;
query.description: Two exact tag rates from existing producer receipts, with denominator population retained for every dataset.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: HP / all alignments = HP-assigned mapped alignment records / all captured mapped alignment records, including primary, secondary, and supplementary.
HP+PS / HP-tagged = alignment records carrying both HP and PS / HP-assigned alignment records.
These are alignment-record metrics and must not be relabeled as unique-read or primary-read rates.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM producer_tag_details ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Exact alignment-class and HP/PS counts plus missing/extra/conflict conservation fields from producer validation receipts.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: total alignments = primary + secondary + supplementary captured mapped alignment records.
HP+PS among HP = HP-and-PS records / HP-assigned records.
duplicate identity rows are reported separately from duplicate identity conflicts.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM topology_rates ORDER BY sample_filter, sample, metric;
query.description: Long-form per-dataset topology coverage and unique-among-tree rates with exact numerators and denominators.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: tree coverage = tree_n / region_n.
unique among tree = unique_tree_n / tree_n.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM region_counts ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Analysis-region counts are shown separately from distinct sSNV counts to avoid a dual-axis comparison.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: count = region_n for one technical dataset; it is not variant burden or recall.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM ssnv_counts ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Distinct topology sSNV counts are shown separately from region opportunity counts.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: count = distinct_ssnv_n for one technical dataset; it is not truth-set sensitivity.

sources.label: HCC1395 ISM linkage by active-k bin

query.sql: SELECT * FROM coverage_by_k ORDER BY sample_filter, k_order, bundle;
query.description: HCC1395 v1/v3 ISM linkage by topology active-k bin; rows are not a multi-sample comparison.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: coverage = linked distinct genomic sSNV / topology distinct genomic sSNV.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM coverage_denominator_rail ORDER BY sample_filter, k_order;
query.description: Compact exact N/D companion to the active-k chart, grouped into one row per k bin.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: v1/v3 coverage = linked / the displayed denominator.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM axis_rates ORDER BY sample_filter, axis, series;
query.description: Exploratory raw-p and within-family BH rates for topology-linked HCC1395 rows.
filters: analysis_scope = topology_linked_distinct_ssnv
metric_definitions: raw rate = rows with raw p <= 0.05 / tested rows.
BH rate = rows with recomputed within-axis-and-scope BH q <= 0.05 / tested rows.
Cluster is circular double-dipping and is invalid as evidence.

sources.label: HCC1395 axis exact denominator and validity rail

query.sql: SELECT * FROM axis_denominator_rail ORDER BY sample_filter, axis;
query.description: One row per topology-linked axis with v1/v3 exact tested, raw, and BH counts; invalid cluster is retained here but excluded from the chart.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: raw rate = raw-significant / tested.
BH rate = BH-significant / tested.
cluster is invalid as evidence because of circular double-dipping.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM bundle_overview ORDER BY sample_filter, bundle;
query.description: Exact HCC1395 v1/v3 bundle metrics, selfcheck status, and asset-accounting gaps.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: ISM linkage = methyl_topology_linked / distinct topology sSNV.
All rate fields are stored as decimal fractions in this artifact.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM topology_details ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Exact topology denominators and technical provenance gates for seven datasets representing six biological samples.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: Technical PASS does not prove a unique biological clone tree.
HCC1395_DORADO is a technical replicate of biological_id HCC1395.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM axis_details ORDER BY sample_filter, bundle, analysis_scope, axis;
query.description: Full v1/v3 axis metrics for both all-summary and topology-linked scopes.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: BH correction is within one bundle x axis x declared scope, not cohort-wide.
Effect units differ by axis and must not be compared across incompatible units.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM lca_summary ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Summarizes the 22-chromosome HCC1395 LCA comparison and its failed causal A/B gate.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: same_in_bam_rate = chromosomes with identical in_bam / shared chromosomes.
same_threads_rate = chromosomes with identical thread count / shared chromosomes.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM visual_qa ORDER BY sample_filter, surface, viewport;
query.description: Desktop/mobile overflow and browser-error receipts for the legacy and direct-generated HCC1395 interfaces.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: browser_error_n = captured browserErrors array length for one surface and viewport.

blocks.body:
## 總覽 — 已接入的 topology／bounded-input gates 完整，下游科學證據仍為 partial

預設 **All** 是 7 datasets＝6 biological＋1 technical replicate；切換 **選擇資料集** 後，指標、圖表與表格會同步隔離。已接入 topology、bounded tumor／normal／reference 與既有 tag receipt；ISM／lineage／truth 等未完成構面維持 unavailable，claim ceiling 仍是描述性觀察與資料產品 QA。

## 機會量 — 先看每組資料能被分析多少

Region 與 distinct sSNV 分開成同層小圖；避免雙軸掩蓋尺度差異，也不把較大的 opportunity 誤稱為較好的樣本。

ALL-SCOPE EVIDENCE ANCHOR

見林、見樹、見極端，也看技術對照

PARTIAL · 描述性

Aggregate · n=6

Tree 77.7% · Unique/tree 62.4%

6 biological rows 的 macro median；IQR 分別 74.0%–78.6%、46.7%–84.2%。

Canonical · HCC1395

11,590 regions · Tree 78.8% · Unique/tree 77.2%

唯一具有 v1/v3 drilldown 的主資料集；可觀察但 bundle 仍 BLOCKED。

Extreme observed · H2009

36,042 regions · Tree 64.2% · Unique/tree 35.3%

在 6 個 biological rows 同時具有最低兩比例；稱 observed extreme，不稱統計 outlier。

Technical control · HCC1395_DORADO

Δ Tree -1.5% · Δ Unique/tree +1.3%

paired biological_id=HCC1395；排除於 biological macro，差值不宣稱 platform effect。

ALL 7 DATASETS · FIXED LABELS

機會量比較：名稱、bar 與精確值同列

各 panel 獨立縮放；長 bar 不代表較高品質。

## 輸入與 phasing readiness — bounded identity，非 full-content attestation

下方兩張卡與 tag 圖會隨資料集選擇器同步更新。Payload MATCH只代表frozen chunks／index／metadata；strict MATCH與MOUNT_DEVICE_DRIFT_ONLY依scope動態重算，缺少@RG、caller配對檢查與full BAM SHA缺口都保留在明細。

## 診斷 — HCC1395 下游選擇與多重比較

保留 linked／denominator 計數，並分開呈現 raw-p discovery 與 family 內 BH correction。v1/v3 視窗不同與 cluster 軸循環性仍是明示 gate。

## 明細 — 精確分母、gate 與 QA 收據

下方是稽核介面：保留技術重複、分析範圍、effect unit、因果 gate 與瀏覽器收據，不壓縮成 pooled cohort claim。

DETAILS ON DEMAND

摺疊式細節與證據界線

主畫面先顯示決策級訊號；需要分母、口徑或缺失欄位時再展開。

01預設 All 範圍目前代表什麼？

7 datasets = 6 biological + 1 technical replicate；hash、identity、receipt 三個技術 gate 都是 7/7 PASS。全 family 完整 0/7；全 objective-certified 0/7。排除技術重複後的 macro tree coverage 為 77.7%（IQR 74.0%–78.6%），macro unique/tree 為 62.4%（IQR 46.7%–84.2%）。

來源：scope_summary；切換資料集後，以頁面上方動態卡片為準。

02比例如何計算，哪些不能互相比？

tree coverage = tree_n / region_n；unique/tree = unique_tree_n / tree_n；ISM linkage = linked sSNV / topology distinct sSNV。raw p 與 family 內 BH 需分開閱讀；不同甲基化軸的 effect unit 不可直接比較。

來源：topology_rates、bundle_overview、axis_rates。

03目前仍缺哪些 multi-BAM QC 與真值資料？

已收集 tumor／paired-normal quickcheck、bounded payload chunks、index SHA、reference dictionary 與既有 LongPhase-S alignment-tag receipt。仍缺 mapping rate、depth／IQR、read N50、primary-read HP／PS、MM／ML 與 CpG 完整度、KDE provenance，以及 truth VCF／high-confidence BED／som.py 指標；缺值維持 null／UNAVAILABLE，絕不以 0 代替。

來源：availability；詳細欄位契約見同目錄的 multi_bam_dashboard_metric_contract.md。

04BAM identity 為何只有 0/7 strict MATCH？

三段 frozen 1 MiB payload 與 BAI 是 7/7 MATCH；all-role strict identity 為 0/7，另有 7/7 被明確分類為 MOUNT_DEVICE_DRIFT_ONLY，逐 role 差異保留在 identity table。此外 7/7 tumor BAM 沒有 @RG，且有 1 筆 BAM↔caller cross-directory review；因此不可宣稱 full-content、完整生物樣本身分或 platform effect。

來源：bam_scope_summary、bam_input_identity；full BAM SHA-256 尚未執行。

## 解讀 guardrails

- Cohort topology 維持每個技術資料集一列，不執行 pooled-locus inference。
- HCC1395_DORADO 為 reproducibility 保留，但不是第 7 個生物樣本；BAM↔caller 跨目錄差異不宣稱 platform effect。
- 頁面顯示為百分比的欄位，在 snapshot 中皆以 0–1 儲存，並保留 exact numerator／denominator。
- Bounded payload MATCH 是 frozen chunks／index／metadata 證據，不是 full BAM content SHA；strict identity category依每個input role重算，不把bounded status升格為full-content PASS。
- LongPhase-S tag 圖使用 all captured mapped alignment records（含 primary／secondary／supplementary），不是 primary-read 或 unique-read rate。
- 缺少的 mapping rate、depth、read N50、primary-read HP/PS、MM/ML completeness、KDE provenance 與 truth benchmark 維持 null，並附明確 access status。
- ISM 可用性會隨 active-k 選擇改變；untested 不等於 nonsignificant。
- Lineage/LCA 在受控輸入身分固定前只能作描述性觀察。
- Browser 截圖只驗證呈現，不驗證生物真值。

query.sql: SELECT * FROM scope_summary ORDER BY sample_filter;
query.description: Counts dataset and biological-sample scope, technical integrity, and audited downstream availability.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: dataset_count = topology dataset rows in the selected view.
biological_count = distinct biological_id values; HCC1395_DORADO remains a technical replicate.
technical_replicate_n = datasets marked technical_replicate=true in the selected view.
hash_match_n, sample_identity_match_n, and receipt_technical_pass_n are separate technical gate counts.
integrity_pass_rate = datasets passing hash, sample identity, and technical receipt gates / datasets in view.
technical_gate_pass_n = datasets with receipt_all_pass=true.
all_families_complete_n = datasets with receipt_all_mutation_bearing_families_complete=true.
all_objective_certified_n = datasets with receipt_all_units_objective_certified=true.
biological macro median/P25/P75 use SQL PERCENTILE_CONT-style linear interpolation and exclude rows marked technical_replicate=true.
downstream_available_count = datasets with an audited drilldown bundle; availability does not imply scientific validation.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM availability ORDER BY sample_filter, component;
query.description: Shows the measured availability boundary for topology, ISM, lineage/LCA, and truth benchmarking.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: coverage = available datasets / expected topology datasets in the selected view.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM bam_scope_summary ORDER BY sample_filter;
query.description: Selected-scope tumor/normal/reference readiness, strict-identity categories, missing read groups, and caller-directory review counts.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: payload sample match = first/middle/last frozen 1 MiB chunks plus size/index checks; it is not a full-content BAM hash.
strict storage identity match = all three roles MATCH; mount-device drift = all three roles are MATCH or MOUNT_DEVICE_DRIFT_ONLY and at least one role has that bounded drift status.
tag receipt pass uses existing producer sidecar validation, not a new primary-read scan.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM bam_input_identity ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Per-dataset bounded payload, BAM index, header dictionary, source-directory pairing, and full-hash availability details.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: tumor_bam_gib and normal_bam_gib = file size bytes / 1024^3.
UNAVAILABLE_NO_RG means BAM headers contain no @RG SM field, so header identity cannot be asserted.
CROSS_DIRECTORY_REVIEW_REQUIRED is a transfer/confound flag, not evidence of corruption.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM read_tag_rates ORDER BY sample_filter, sample, metric;
query.description: Two exact tag rates from existing producer receipts, with denominator population retained for every dataset.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: HP / all alignments = HP-assigned mapped alignment records / all captured mapped alignment records, including primary, secondary, and supplementary.
HP+PS / HP-tagged = alignment records carrying both HP and PS / HP-assigned alignment records.
These are alignment-record metrics and must not be relabeled as unique-read or primary-read rates.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM producer_tag_details ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Exact alignment-class and HP/PS counts plus missing/extra/conflict conservation fields from producer validation receipts.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: total alignments = primary + secondary + supplementary captured mapped alignment records.
HP+PS among HP = HP-and-PS records / HP-assigned records.
duplicate identity rows are reported separately from duplicate identity conflicts.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM topology_rates ORDER BY sample_filter, sample, metric;
query.description: Long-form per-dataset topology coverage and unique-among-tree rates with exact numerators and denominators.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: tree coverage = tree_n / region_n.
unique among tree = unique_tree_n / tree_n.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM region_counts ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Analysis-region counts are shown separately from distinct sSNV counts to avoid a dual-axis comparison.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: count = region_n for one technical dataset; it is not variant burden or recall.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM ssnv_counts ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Distinct topology sSNV counts are shown separately from region opportunity counts.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: count = distinct_ssnv_n for one technical dataset; it is not truth-set sensitivity.

sources.label: HCC1395 ISM linkage by active-k bin

query.sql: SELECT * FROM coverage_by_k ORDER BY sample_filter, k_order, bundle;
query.description: HCC1395 v1/v3 ISM linkage by topology active-k bin; rows are not a multi-sample comparison.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: coverage = linked distinct genomic sSNV / topology distinct genomic sSNV.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM coverage_denominator_rail ORDER BY sample_filter, k_order;
query.description: Compact exact N/D companion to the active-k chart, grouped into one row per k bin.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: v1/v3 coverage = linked / the displayed denominator.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM axis_rates ORDER BY sample_filter, axis, series;
query.description: Exploratory raw-p and within-family BH rates for topology-linked HCC1395 rows.
filters: analysis_scope = topology_linked_distinct_ssnv
metric_definitions: raw rate = rows with raw p <= 0.05 / tested rows.
BH rate = rows with recomputed within-axis-and-scope BH q <= 0.05 / tested rows.
Cluster is circular double-dipping and is invalid as evidence.

sources.label: HCC1395 axis exact denominator and validity rail

query.sql: SELECT * FROM axis_denominator_rail ORDER BY sample_filter, axis;
query.description: One row per topology-linked axis with v1/v3 exact tested, raw, and BH counts; invalid cluster is retained here but excluded from the chart.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: raw rate = raw-significant / tested.
BH rate = BH-significant / tested.
cluster is invalid as evidence because of circular double-dipping.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM bundle_overview ORDER BY sample_filter, bundle;
query.description: Exact HCC1395 v1/v3 bundle metrics, selfcheck status, and asset-accounting gaps.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: ISM linkage = methyl_topology_linked / distinct topology sSNV.
All rate fields are stored as decimal fractions in this artifact.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM topology_details ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Exact topology denominators and technical provenance gates for seven datasets representing six biological samples.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: Technical PASS does not prove a unique biological clone tree.
HCC1395_DORADO is a technical replicate of biological_id HCC1395.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM axis_details ORDER BY sample_filter, bundle, analysis_scope, axis;
query.description: Full v1/v3 axis metrics for both all-summary and topology-linked scopes.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: BH correction is within one bundle x axis x declared scope, not cohort-wide.
Effect units differ by axis and must not be compared across incompatible units.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM lca_summary ORDER BY sample_filter, sample;
query.description: Summarizes the 22-chromosome HCC1395 LCA comparison and its failed causal A/B gate.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: same_in_bam_rate = chromosomes with identical in_bam / shared chromosomes.
same_threads_rate = chromosomes with identical thread count / shared chromosomes.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM visual_qa ORDER BY sample_filter, surface, viewport;
query.description: Desktop/mobile overflow and browser-error receipts for the legacy and direct-generated HCC1395 interfaces.
filters: No source rows excluded unless stated in the description.
metric_definitions: browser_error_n = captured browserErrors array length for one surface and viewport.
